command:
set -eu
git fetch --quiet --no-tags origin refs/heads/main
SHA=$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)
printf 'MAIN=%s\n' "$SHA"
printf '%s\n' '--- CURRENT EFFECT SOURCE PATHS ---'
git ls-tree -r --name-only "$SHA" | grep -Ei '(^|/)(omega[^/]*|.*local_bridge.*|.*effect.*|.*sandbox.*|.*alignment.*|.*interlock.*)(/|$|\.)' | grep -Ev '(^|/)(dump|research_sources|research_entity/trigger_runs|free swarm)/' | tail -n 260 || true
printf '%s\n' '--- CURRENT POLICY SYMBOLS ---'
git grep -n -E 'DELETE_REMOVAL_DENIED|STORAGE_FORMAT_DENIED|EXACT_BOUND_REQUEST_ADMITTED|NOT_YET_GRANTED|EffectGate|effect authority|execution boundary' "$SHA" -- 'tools/**' 'runtime_checks/**' 'governance/**' 'DEV_SOURCE_RESEARCH/**' 'research_entity/coordination/**' 2>/dev/null | head -n 280 || true
